description: KeePassRPC V3: a full-entry KeePass API behind a subject-aware ACL for automation and AI agents. This fork installs as its own plugin, so install it or upstream's keepass-plugin-keepassrpc, not both.
notes: This is a fork of KeePassRPC. It ships the same KeePassRPC.plgx filename as upstream, so KeePass loads whichever one is present. Do not install this alongside upstream's keepass-plugin-keepassrpc.
Restart KeePass after installing so it compiles and loads the plugin.
